query:
SELECT p.id AS "id!"
        FROM scanned_job_posts p
        JOIN job_searches s ON s.id = p.job_search_id
        WHERE s.active = 1
          AND (
            (p.status = 'new' AND p.found_at < ?1)
            OR (p.status = 'matching' AND (p.matching_since IS NULL OR p.matching_since < ?1))
          )
        ORDER BY p.found_at, p.id
